note: House League items, batch 4 of 4 (DC-H4): three tactical cards played with a throw and two Charms on existing rule pieces, written and landed together by E18-C11; with them the House League has all 40 of its items. Amounts and prices are provisional (E24).

design.trigger: Arm it with a throw: the first pin that throw knocks down directly scores its effects one more time, like an Echo Ball's repeat, with any ball. Exhausted for the run.
design.pool: Shop Tactical slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A doubled pin outline over the first pin hit; the repeat shows in the explanation as from Double Take.

design.trigger: Arm it with the first throw of a frame: ×2 Mult if that frame ends as a strike. Exhausted for the run, strike or not.
design.pool: Shop Tactical slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A pointing hand at the pocket; it lights on a strike and greys out otherwise.

design.trigger: Arm it with a throw: +5 Value for every pin down in that frame. Exhausted for the run.
design.pool: Shop Tactical slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A tally card that ticks once per pin down in the frame.

design.trigger: +5 Mult on a spare after a first roll that left at least two pins standing.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A broom crew sweeping the leave; it shows the first-roll leave against the 2 it needs.

design.trigger: +7 Mult on an open frame that ends with exactly three pins standing (seven down).
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A lucky 7 die; it lands on 7 only when exactly seven pins are down.
